if: the document is a revised tax invoice referred to in section 31
it is issued under rule 53(1) of the CGST Rules, 2017
then: the revised tax invoice MUST carry the signature or digital signature of the supplier or his authorised representative
note: One mandatory particular of rule 53(1)(j), addressable on its own so that a missing field names the clause it breaches.
